name: ColorInput
description: Compact colour field: a colour well plus an editable hex text input that opens the full color_picker in a popover (desktop) or dialog.

fields.pickerMode: ColorPickerMode? - channel mode the picker opens in, rgb by default
fields.showAlpha: bool? - picker alpha editing, true by default
fields.enableEyeDropper: bool? - picker screen sampling, true by default
fields.showHistory: bool? - picker history toggle, true by default
fields.popoverAlignment: AlignmentGeometry? - popover placement, top-left by default
fields.popoverAnchorAlignment: AlignmentGeometry? - popover anchor edge, bottom-left by default
fields.popoverPadding: EdgeInsetsGeometry? - popover inner padding, 16 by default
fields.gap: double? - gap between the well and the hex field, 8 by default
fields.swatchSize: double? - colour well edge, 36 by default
fields.swatchBorderRadius: BorderRadiusGeometry? - well corner radius, ambient radiusMd
fields.swatchBorderColor: ThemedColor? - well border, the border token
